title: Keto Rich Mexican Pork Pozole
description: A rich and cozy Mexican dish featuring dried leaves of summer savory, reduced to be keto-friendly, in the form of a hearty pozole.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, dried summer savory leaves, salt, and pepper to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Add the shredded cabbage and sliced radishes to the pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and serve hot.
Garnish with additional summer savory leaves, if desired.
Serve with a side of keto-friendly toppings, such as diced avocado or sour cream.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
